name: DGMGR_ST_WAIT_CINE
meaning: Update 0: -> 1 when the cinematic trigger fired (inferred)

name: DGMGR_ST_CINEMATIC
meaning: SetState 1: StartSceneInline(cineId); Update: -> 3 when it ends (inferred)

name: DGMGR_ST_DANCE
meaning: SetState 2: beat clock reset; Update: runs UpdateBeatTrack, -> 4 when the round ends (inferred)

name: DGMGR_ST_PLACE_WOLF
meaning: SetState 3: next step, SetGameFlags(0x10); Update: walks the Wolf to stepCenter (MSG_SET5_GOTO) (inferred)

name: DGMGR_ST_ROUND_END
meaning: SetState 4: ClearGameFlags(0x10), tambourine ghosts reset; Update: after 3000 ms -> 3 or 5 (inferred)
